SELECT s.course_id, s.sec_id, s.semester, s.year, s.building, s.room_number, s.time_slot_id, c.title AS course_title, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(i.name SEPARATOR '、') FROM teaches t JOIN instructor i ON t.ID = i.ID WHERE t.course_id = s.course_id AND t.sec_id = s.sec_id AND t.semester = s.semester AND t.year = s.year) AS instructor_names, (SELECT t.ID FROM teaches t WHERE t.course_id = s.course_id AND t.sec_id = s.sec_id AND t.semester = s.semester AND t.year = s.year LIMIT 1) AS instructor_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takes k WHERE k.course_id = s.course_id AND k.sec_id = s.sec_id AND k.semester = s.semester AND k.year = s.year) AS enrolled, cl.capacity FROM section s LEFT JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN classroom cl ON s.building = cl.building AND s.room_number = cl.room_number
ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.semester, s.course_id, s.sec_id

ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.semester, s.course_id, s.sec_id LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT s.course_id, s.sec_id, s.semester, s.year, s.building, s.room_number, s.time_slot_id, c.title AS course_title, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(i.name SEPARATOR '、') FROM teaches t JOIN instructor i ON t.ID = i.ID WHERE t.course_id = s.course_id AND t.sec_id = s.sec_id AND t.semester = s.semester AND t.year = s.year) AS instructor_names, (SELECT t.ID FROM teaches t WHERE t.course_id = s.course_id AND t.sec_id = s.sec_id AND t.semester = s.semester AND t.year = s.year LIMIT 1) AS instructor_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takes k WHERE k.course_id = s.course_id AND k.sec_id = s.sec_id AND k.semester = s.semester AND k.year = s.year) AS enrolled, cl.capacity FROM section s LEFT JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN classroom cl ON s.building = cl.building AND s.room_number = cl.room_number ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.semester, s.course_id, s.sec_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO section (course_id, sec_id, semester, year, building, room_number, time_slot_id) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{secId}, #{semester}, #{year}, #{building}, #{roomNumber}, #{timeSlotId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teaches t JOIN section s ON t.course_id = s.course_id AND t.sec_id = s.sec_id AND t.semester = s.semester AND t.year = s.year JOIN time_slot ts ON ts.time_slot_id = s.time_slot_id JOIN time_slot nt ON nt.time_slot_id = #{timeSlotId} WHERE t.ID = #{instructorId} AND s.semester = #{semester} AND s.year = #{year} AND ts.day = nt.day AND ts.start_time < nt.end_time AND nt.start_time < ts.end_time AND NOT (s.course_id = #{courseId} AND s.sec_id = #{secId})
